booster.note: Falcon 9 Block 5 boosters land on a droneship or back at the Cape, decided for each launch and not yet published for this one. On the flown CLPS launches: IM-1 on Landing Zone 1; Blue Ghost Mission 1 on a droneship 700 km downrange; IM-2 on a droneship 700 km downrange.

model_check.note: From OSIRIS-REx’s reconstructed entry state, the entry model lands its capsule 9.5 km from where the recovery team found it (6.7 to 12.2 km over the published drag range; the limit is 10 km). The mission’s own simulation from the same state, before the day’s atmosphere was known, was 8.9 km off. Its 99 % landing area, 51.4 by 21.4 km, holds the real landing point.
